# Nodics Support

Nodics is source-available commercial software. Support is provided according to
the active commercial/support agreement for the customer, partner, or evaluation
scope.

## Support scope

Support may include:

- framework setup and upgrade guidance;
- production SLA handling when covered by contract;
- provider integration guidance for MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, media
  storage, authentication, deployment, and observability;
- security triage and incident-response coordination;
- migration planning for deprecated APIs or compatibility shims.

## Unsupported assumptions

Public repository access does not automatically include production support,
hosted operations, custom-module development, or emergency response unless a
written agreement includes those services.
